description: Swetrix is an open-source, privacy-focused web analytics platform that provides traffic analytics, performance monitoring, and error tracking without cookies. It also offers self-hosting and related products such as CAPTCHA.
summary: Swetrix exposes documented HTTP APIs for analytics reads (Statistics API v1 and v2), event ingestion, and administration; no public GraphQL API, MCP server, or CLI was found for swetrix.com.
